# SvgImageEmbedding

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

How raster images are represented in exported SVG.

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Values

- `DataUri`: Embed the image bytes inline as a `data:` URI (default).
- `ExternalRef`: Reserved for an external `href` reference mode (treated as `DataUri` until implemented).
- `Omit`: Omit images entirely.
